latest_release.name: v2.3.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

## ✨ Added

**Piccolo Local Decision Models**

- Add Piccolo 4B, 9B, and 27B as local decision models for tool review and context compaction, with BF16 and Q8_0 recommendations, runtime installation and updates, and Hugging Face or ModelScope downloads. Review and compaction remain opt-in; the local runtime serves one model at a time ([#8463](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/8463), [#8573](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/8573))

**QwenPaw Community**

- Browse, sort, and comment on QwenPaw Community posts from the Console, draft resource-linked issue reports with model assistance, and open the community editor. Connect an account to sync selected message categories to the Inbox and desktop notifications ([#7903](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/7903))

**Console & Desktop**

- Add the optional OpenUI plugin to display interactive forms and components within replies, preserve their state during streaming, and submit actions to the originating conversation ([#8239](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/8239), [#8248](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/8248))
- Add an unread-only filter to Inbox push messages so older unread messages are easier to find ([#8484](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/8484))
- Let desktop windows share one background service, keep tasks running after closing the last window, and coordinate updates across windows; preserve unsent drafts when the service reconnects ([#8373](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/8373))
- Receive browser and desktop notifications for approvals, completed replies, and background tasks, including when the desktop is minimized to the tray; click a notification to return to the relevant conversation or approval ([#8504](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/8504))

**Agent Modes**

- Add Advisor Mode: pair an advisor model with a worker model, prepare an opening plan, consult the advisor when needed, and adjust the plan after repeated tool failures ([#7569](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/7569))
- Add experimental Python Code Mode to combine enabled tools in one script, including concurrent calls and ordered text and media output. Native tool permissions still apply; Code Mode does not enable the sandbox, which is off by default ([#8224](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/8224))
- Select an initial Agent mode for new ACP sessions with `qwenpaw acp --agent-mode` ([#8352](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/8352))
- Optionally use a decision model to check conversation and tool evidence for unfinished work during completion self-checks; retain the original self-check when the model is unavailable or uncertain. This option is off by default ([#8544](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/8544))

**Memory**

- Upgrade ReMe to 0.4.2.0 with image memory, automatic tags, tag-filtered search, and decision-model context compaction that retains references to original tool output. Image memory, automatic tagging, and decision compaction are off by default; Auto-Dream now focuses on consolidating memory ([#8347](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/8347))
- Browse ReMe Light memory files through clickable tags and a Tags tab, with file counts, pagination, and preserved unsaved edits when opening the same file from different views ([#8470](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/8470))
- Add an OpenViking memory plugin with automatic recall, completed-turn persistence, and explicit memory search through a configured OpenViking service ([#7613](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/7613))

**Models & Approvals**

- Sign in with a ChatGPT subscription on a local installation and select models available to the account without a Platform API key; support account switching and sign-out. Remote and Hub sign-in are not supported ([#8437](https://github.com/agentscope-ai/QwenPaw/pull/8437))
